package middleware

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/imajinyun/gofly/rest"
)

func TestPresetSessionHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	config := SessionConfig{Secret: []byte("test-only-session-secret-32-bytes!")}
	for _, test := range []struct{ name, cookie, want string }{
		{name: "header alone"},
		{name: "valid cookie wins", cookie: SignSession("server-selected", config.Secret), want: "server-selected"},
		{name: "tampered cookie", cookie: SignSession("forged", []byte("wrong-secret"))},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(SessionMiddleware(config)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"id": SessionID(r, config), "header": r.Header.Get("X-Gofly-Session-Id")})
			})))
			defer server.Close()
			request, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, server.URL, nil)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			request.Header.Set("X-Gofly-Session-Id", "client-selected")
			if test.cookie != "" {
				request.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: "gofly_session", Value: test.cookie})
			}
			response, err := server.Client().Do(request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer response.Body.Close()
			if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d", response.StatusCode)
			}
			var body map[string]string
			if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			cookies := response.Cookies()
			if len(cookies) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("cookies=%v", cookies)
			}
			if !cookies[0].Secure || !cookies[0].HttpOnly || cookies[0].SameSite != http.SameSiteLaxMode {
				t.Fatalf("unsafe default session cookie: %+v", cookies[0])
			}
			id, valid := VerifySession(cookies[0].Value, config.Secret)
			if !valid || id == "client-selected" || id == "forged" || id == "" {
				t.Fatalf("accepted untrusted identity: id=%q valid=%t", id, valid)
			}
			if body["id"] != id || body["header"] != id {
				t.Fatalf("handler identity=%v cookie=%q", body, id)
			}
			if test.want != "" && id != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("id=%q want=%q", id, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("missing secret fails closed", func(t *testing.T) {
		server := httptest.NewServer(SessionMiddleware(SessionConfig{})(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) { t.Error("handler ran without session secret") })))
		defer server.Close()
		response, err := server.Client().Get(server.URL)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer response.Body.Close()
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusInternalServerError || len(response.Cookies()) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("status=%d cookies=%v", response.StatusCode, response.Cookies())
		}
	})
}

func TestPresetSessionContextRequiresMatchingConfig(t *testing.T) {
	config := SessionConfig{Secret: []byte("test-only-session-secret-32-bytes!")}
	other := SessionConfig{Secret: []byte("different-test-only-signing-key!")}
	server := httptest.NewServer(SessionMiddleware(config)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, SessionID(r, other))
	})))
	defer server.Close()
	response, err := server.Client().Get(server.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(body) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("another signing-key scope received identity %q", body)
	}
}

func TestPresetSessionLocalHTTPOptIn(t *testing.T) {
	for _, forceSecure := range []bool{false, true} {
		config := SessionConfig{Secret: []byte("test-only-session-secret-32-bytes!"), AllowInsecureCookies: true, Secure: forceSecure}
		server := httptest.NewServer(SessionMiddleware(config)(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) })))
		response, err := server.Client().Get(server.URL)
		if err != nil {
			server.Close()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cookies := response.Cookies()
		response.Body.Close()
		server.Close()
		if len(cookies) != 1 || cookies[0].Secure != forceSecure || !cookies[0].HttpOnly {
			t.Fatalf("forceSecure=%t cookies=%v", forceSecure, cookies)
		}
	}
}

func TestPresetBreakerSSE(t *testing.T) {
	release := make(chan struct{})
	server := httptest.NewServer(CircuitBreakerMiddleware(CircuitBreakerConfig{})(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		c := &rest.Context{Response: w, Request: r}
		if err := c.SSE(rest.SSEEvent{Data: "ready"}); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("SSE: %v", err)
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-release:
		case <-r.Context().Done():
		}
	})))
	defer server.Close()
	defer close(release)
	client := server.Client()
	client.Timeout = 2 * time.Second
	response, err := client.Get(server.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("event was not flushed before handler completion: %v", err)
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	line, err := bufio.NewReader(response.Body).ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil || line != "data: ready\n" {
		t.Fatalf("first SSE line=%q error=%v", line, err)
	}
}

func TestPresetBreakerWebSocket(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(CircuitBreakerMiddleware(CircuitBreakerConfig{})(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		c := &rest.Context{Response: w, Request: r}
		if err := WebSocketEcho(c, WebSocketConfig{}); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
	})))
	defer server.Close()
	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", server.Listener.Addr().String(), 2*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	if err := conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = fmt.Fprintf(conn, "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: %s\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==\r\n\r\n", server.Listener.Addr())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	response, err := http.ReadResponse(bufio.NewReader(conn), nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusSwitchingProtocols {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
		response.Body.Close()
		t.Fatalf("upgrade=%d body=%s", response.StatusCode, body)
	}
}

func TestPresetBreakerImplicitStatus(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(CircuitBreakerMiddleware(CircuitBreakerConfig{FailureThreshold: 1, OpenTimeout: time.Minute})(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "ok")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
	})))
	defer server.Close()
	for attempt := range 2 {
		response, err := server.Client().Get(server.URL)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
		response.Body.Close()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) != "ok" {
			t.Fatalf("attempt=%d status=%d body=%s", attempt, response.StatusCode, body)
		}
	}
}

type failingPresetFlushWriter struct {
	*httptest.ResponseRecorder
	err error
}

func (w *failingPresetFlushWriter) FlushError() error { return w.err }

func TestPresetBreakerFlushError(t *testing.T) {
	want := errors.New("connection flush failed")
	writer := &failingPresetFlushWriter{ResponseRecorder: httptest.NewRecorder(), err: want}
	var got error
	CircuitBreakerMiddleware(CircuitBreakerConfig{})(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		got = http.NewResponseController(w).Flush()
	})).ServeHTTP(writer, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	if !errors.Is(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("flush error=%v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}
